# Classroom Clipart

> > Free, downloadable clipart, vectors, and graphics for educational and classroom use with an online editor for customization.

Classroom Clipart provides a comprehensive collection of free educational graphics including vector clipart, PNGs, and photos organized by themes like nature, holidays, and seasons. The site features an online image editor tool that allows users to customize clipart and add text for classroom and educational projects.

## Key Topics

- Vector Graphics
- Free Clipart Download
- Educational Graphics
- Classroom Resources
- Holiday Clipart

- Spring Clipart
- National Bike to School Day

- PNG/SVG/EPS Formats
- Online Image Editor
- Spring Forward
- School Transportation
- Reading Celebration

- [Free Clipart, Vectors, PNGs and Photos | Classroom Clipart](https://classroomclipart.com): Classroom Clipart homepage offering free clipart, vectors, PNGs for educational use
